sourceOfTruthForIndividualDecisions: The two immutable uploaded JSON source files (linked by sourceRepoPath).
safeguards: 3-star quality asks for alternative paintings; do not reject the existing candidate until another is rated higher.
4-star photo quality asks for better quality images of same exact physical original painting, not unrelated paintings.
5-star photo quality denotes user-perceived perfect image; if status is not_reviewed do not infer an explicit primary selection. Verify physical original, file master and licence before production.
A protected old 12 October selected artwork remains valid even without five stars.
Image not reviewed does not prove image failed to load. Only explicit imageLoadFailures confirms browser errors; sourceMissingOct12 means no proper photo linked.
A duplicate choice excludes that file from the preferred shortlist but does not delete the source original.
Never alter the prior human 5-star painting ratings or publish automatically.
